executive_summary: This week the NA Core Spanish Voice queue recorded an actual offered volume of 8,805 contacts against a forecast of only 91 contacts, driving the Forecast Adherence KPI to -9,599.7% – a massive under‑forecast. The figure is far outside anything this queue has ever seen and the following weeks immediately return to normal levels, indicating a likely data‑quality issue that must be validated at source. The same directional miss is already present at the Region level, so the problem is not isolated to this queue; however, the extreme magnitude suggests either a genuine demand surge or a reporting error that needs confirmation before any forecast adjustments are made.
business_impact: If the volume is real, the plan would have severely under‑staffed the queue, risking service levels and customer experience; if the volume is erroneous, acting on it would waste effort chasing a phantom spike.
